detailed_description:
Photoreal live-action, Utah mountains, 1860, low sun from the right, black shadow, 35 mm film grain.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:08. The shot begins from <Picture 2>: a wide up the black defile at dawn, the snow-capped peaks above lit red and gold from the right one after another, the pines rimmed along the right bank, the trail a pale thread up the black floor. The camera is on the trail at a standing man's eye, a 35mm lens. The low sun comes from the RIGHT over the peaks. At the first frame the lit peaks fill the TOP third of the frame from edge to edge. The black left bank fills the LEFT edge and the pines rimmed in sun the RIGHT edge. The pale trail runs from the BOTTOM CENTRE up the black floor to the far bend at the CENTRE. The camera tilts up across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth as the sun's light comes down the peaks from the right one after another, from 00:00 to 00:04. At 00:04 a thread of mist lifts off the black floor, and the lift continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:08 the camera is tilting up through the last frame, and the action continues with it.
